verdict.rationale: Postman is primarily an API client/testing/collaboration platform; the only gateway-adjacent evidence (postman-docs-7) covers registering an MCP server with 'Fabric Gateway,' not traffic-shaping or rate-limiting features. No evidence anywhere in the pack shows Postman enforcing rate limits per consumer or route. Missing for 10: any documentation of rate-limiting configuration, consumer/route-level quotas, or gateway policy enforcement.
